newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Nov 19.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Nov 19.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on November 19. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
Indonesia's parliamentary elections will be on May 29 next year, the country's official election body said.

Five Indonesian detectives are to receive cash awards for their part in returning a fugitive actress to the country to face charges of possessing almost 30,000 pills of the designer drug Ecstasy. Zarima was arrested earlier this month but then escaped to Houston, Texas, after evading police in Indonesia.
Indonesia's Attorney General has given independent labour leader Muchtar Pakpahan four years in jail for his involvement in riots in Medan in 1994.
Transactions on the Jakarta Stock Exchange have increased by 90 percent from January to November to reach a total value of 61.36 trillion rupiah, the exchange reported.
